facts.text: ALSEP Central Station was deployed at Descartes Highlands during Apollo 16 in 1972.
Apollo 16's experiment package included a passive seismometer, active seismometer (with mortar-launched grenades), magnetometer, and heat flow experiment. Transmitted data until 1977.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Its active seismic experiment used mortar-launched grenades and thumper charges to map the subsurface, revealing a 12-metre-deep fragmental regolith layer over fractured bedrock at Descartes.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Descartes Highlands.
Operated until 30 September 1977; the mortar package was only partially fired due to risk of damaging nearby instruments.
